summary.text: Trevor Morse is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Morse advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, receiving 487 votes (44.8%) in a race in which the top two finishers advanced for the district's two seats.
